text.title: Mixed-Methods Triangulation Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on how many genuinely independent legs are obtainable, whether the claim concerns future behaviour without a revealed-preference leg, and whether claims were registered before any results were read — to a full convergence map, a capped-confidence result, or a skip to a single-method read.

decision-tree.root-question: How many sources differ in at least two of sampling frame, collection mode and analyst — and are obtainable inside the decision window?

branch.when: only one genuinely independent source, or every candidate derives from the same events table or the same recruited panel

conclusion.verdict: skip; plural sources over one frame are not triangulation. Run the single method and record confidence=low rather than manufacturing agreement

branch.when: at least 3 sources differ on two or more of frame, mode and analyst
branch.question: Is the claim about what people will do — pay, switch, adopt, churn — or about what they have already done?

branch.when: a will-do claim with no transaction, usage log, pre-order or cancellation record available as a leg

conclusion.verdict: either add a revealed-preference leg or cap the claim at confidence=low; interviews plus survey cannot carry a future-behaviour claim even under full convergence

branch.when: the claim concerns observed behaviour, or a revealed-preference leg is available for the will-do claim
branch.question: Were the claims written as falsifiable propositions with explicit thresholds before any leg's results were read?

branch.when: results from at least one leg were already read before the claims were written down

conclusion.verdict: proceed, but label those claims exploratory — they cannot reach confidence=high no matter how well the legs converge

branch.when: claims with thresholds are registered and no leg's results have been opened yet

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; record the instrument per leg, fill the convergence map, resolve every divergence into one named category, and cap confidence at the weakest leg
